selectionRoute: Complete paginated OPF slide derivatives; ordinary shipped CLI convert; no PPTX/XML mutation

findings.message: The PPTX names Aptos, Aptos Display, which are not on every Windows and macOS machine or not measured exactly by OPF. A viewer without them substitutes another font, and lines can break differently from the preview.
findings.help: Export with --typefaces safe (typefaces: "safe") to write Office-safe families and lay the text out with them, or install the fonts on the machines that open the file.

findings.message: The venn is exported as native shapes, not live SmartArt: Basic Venn text and edits are awaiting native qualification.
findings.help: The pyramid, matrix or cycle is exported as editable native shapes, which look the same; live SmartArt is written only where PowerPoint draws it exactly as the preview (docs/smartart.md). Shorten the entries named in the message, or give the region other proportions, to get live SmartArt. When the message names the fallback picture, install @openpresentation/opf-render: every live SmartArt carries OPF's picture of it for apps without SmartArt.
